visible_BCE: Reweights BOTH known-visible and known-nonvisible facts. It is not a positive-only preservation penalty.
normalization: BCE known-fact denominator excludes exact-unknown odd masks>1. Therefore its denominator can differ from partial-informative NLL. A positive cell is not generally exactly doubled in the full objective; doubling holds only in isolated normalized fixtures.
gates: Source admission uses unchanged Torch2.5 CPU source evaluator with exact pV>=.5/confidence maxjoint>=.5 and fixed V65 source reference counts. GPU macroNLL remains the frozen checkpoint selector. CPU audits cannot reselect checkpoint/threshold.
source_scope: Both V67 input caches are immutable V66 admitted source caches. Current223 used only as RGB SHA denylist, no annotations/scores/features. No current inference is authorized by a failed source gate.
